title: Unit 7 Consolidation: Costa Rica
goal: Review the nature, the abolition of the army, the welfare state, forests and energy, and the farms and regions of Costa Rica, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: cleft sentences, no es que… sino que…, el hecho de que, antes de que and después de que, infinitive and que + subjunctive

items: I can review what I learned about Costa Rica, from its volcanoes to its regions.
I can use cleft sentences, *no es que… sino que…*, *el hecho de que*, *antes de que* and *después de que*.
I can choose between an infinitive and *que* + subjunctive.
I can put events from 1941 to 2026 in order.
I can put a place, a time or an idea in the spotlight with *Fue… donde* and *Lo que… es…*.
I can correct a reason with *No es que… sino que…* (review).
I can comment on a known fact with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive (review).
I can say what came before or after someone else's action, with *antes de que* and *después de que*, and choose between an infinitive and *que* + subjunctive.
